SELECT MATERIAL_ID AS ITEM_SEQ, MATERIAL_CODE AS ITEM_CODE, MATERIAL_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, MATERIAL_SPEC AS ITEM_SPEC FROM TCO403 WHERE FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND ISNULL(DELETE_FLAG, '') != '1'
AND MATERIAL_CODE LIKE '%' + #{searchWrd} + '%'
AND MATERIAL_NAME LIKE '%' + #{searchWrd} + '%'
ORDER BY MATERIAL_CODE
OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TCO403 WHERE FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND ISNULL(DELETE_FLAG, '') != '1'
AND MATERIAL_CODE LIKE '%' + #{searchWrd} + '%'
AND MATERIAL_NAME LIKE '%' + #{searchWrd} + '%'

;WITH BOM_SOURCE AS ( SELECT T.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY T.COMPANY_SEQ, T.ITEM_SEQ ORDER BY T.PROC_SEQ, T.SERL ) AS CHILD_NO FROM TCO501 T ), BOM_TREE AS ( SELECT S.COMPANY_SEQ, S.ITEM_SEQ, S.BOM_REV, S.PROC_REV, S.PROC_SEQ, S.SERL, S.MAT_ITEM_SEQ, S.UNIT_SEQ, S.NEED_QTY_NUMERATOR, S.NEED_QTY_DENOMINATOR, S.SM_DELV_TYPE, S.UPPER_ITEM_SEQ, S.UPPER_BOM_REV, S.BOM_ITEM_SERL, S.LAST_USER_SEQ, S.LAST_DATE_TIME, CAST('|' + CAST(S.ITEM_SEQ AS VARCHAR(20)) + '|' AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS VISITED_PATH, CAST(RIGHT('00' + CAST(S.CHILD_NO AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS SORT_PATH FROM BOM_SOURCE S WHERE S.ITEM_SEQ = #{itemSeq}
UNION ALL SELECT C.COMPANY_SEQ, C.ITEM_SEQ, C.BOM_REV, C.PROC_REV, C.PROC_SEQ, C.SERL, C.MAT_ITEM_SEQ, C.UNIT_SEQ, C.NEED_QTY_NUMERATOR, C.NEED_QTY_DENOMINATOR, C.SM_DELV_TYPE, C.UPPER_ITEM_SEQ, C.UPPER_BOM_REV, C.BOM_ITEM_SERL, C.LAST_USER_SEQ, C.LAST_DATE_TIME, CAST(B.VISITED_PATH + CAST(C.ITEM_SEQ AS VARCHAR(20)) + '|' AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS VISITED_PATH, CAST(B.SORT_PATH + '-' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(C.CHILD_NO AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS SORT_PATH FROM BOM_TREE B INNER JOIN BOM_SOURCE C ON C.COMPANY_SEQ = B.COMPANY_SEQ AND C.ITEM_SEQ = B.MAT_ITEM_SEQ WHERE B.VISITED_PATH NOT LIKE '%|' + CAST(C.ITEM_SEQ AS VARCHAR(20)) + '|%' ) SELECT T.SORT_PATH AS DEPTH, T.ITEM_SEQ, ITEM.MATERIAL_CODE AS ITEM_CODE, ITEM.MATERIAL_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, T.PROC_SEQ, T.SERL, T.MAT_ITEM_SEQ, MAT.MATERIAL_CODE AS MAT_ITEM_NO, MAT.MATERIAL_NAME AS MAT_ITEM_NAME, MAT.MATERIAL_SPEC AS MAT_ITEM_SPEC, T.NEED_QTY_NUMERATOR, T.NEED_QTY_DENOMINATOR, UNIT_CODE.CODE_NM AS UNIT_NAME, T.SM_DELV_TYPE FROM BOM_TREE T LEFT JOIN TCO403 ITEM ON CAST(T.ITEM_SEQ AS VARCHAR(20)) = ITEM.MATERIAL_ID AND ISNULL(ITEM.DELETE_FLAG, '') != '1' LEFT JOIN TCO403 MAT ON CAST(T.MAT_ITEM_SEQ AS VARCHAR(20)) = MAT.MATERIAL_ID AND ISNULL(MAT.DELETE_FLAG, '') != '1' LEFT JOIN MES_CCMMNDETAIL_CODE UNIT_CODE ON UNIT_CODE.CODE_ID = 'COM007' AND MAT.UNIT = UNIT_CODE.CODE ORDER BY T.SORT_PATH OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0)
